CanonicalKeywords.rationale: `{ CardKeyword.Exhaust }` (Discovery.cs:15) == `self.exhausts = True`. Crucially this is set in `_init_vars`, NOT as a class attribute, precisely so the upgrade's `RemoveKeyword` can be undone by `downgrade()`'s rebuild -- and `py audit/tools/card_probes.py downgrade` confirms discovery is NOT among the five sticky cards. This is the pattern aggression/apparition/hello_world/juggling/wish are missing.

ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Skill, CardRarity.Uncommon, TargetType.Self)` (Discovery.cs:17-20) == cost 1 / SKILL / UNCOMMON / SELF.

OnPlay.issue: The SHAPE is right -- generate 3 distinct cards, choose 1, make it free this turn, add it to hand -- and both sides apply `SetToFreeThisTurn` BEFORE the pile add, which matters because the sim's `set_free_this_turn` is cleared by the turn-start reset (cards/base.py:265-269) exactly like C#'s EndOfTurn expiration. TWO DIVERGENCES. (1) WRONG RNG STREAM: `CardFactory.GetDistinctForCombat(Owner, Owner.Character.CardPool.GetUnlockedCards(...), 3, Owner.RunState.Rng.CombatCardGeneration)` (Discovery.cs:27) names the CombatCardGeneration stream; the sim calls `random_pool_cards(ctx.combat._rng, 3, distinct=True)` (colorless_skills.py:222), i.e. the unseeded shared `random.Random`, even though `ctx.combat.combat_rng.card_gen` maps to `combat_card_generation` (combat_rng.py:20,52). `random_pool_cards` also uses `rng.sample` (pool.py:158) where GetDistinctForCombat draws from the named stream, so the draw count differs too. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/anointed's and card/beat_down's OnPlay entries (rule 3); LIVE, and this card is one of the 21 the `shared-rng` probe lists. (2) `canSkip: true` (Discovery.cs:28) is not modelled: `CombatState.select_cards` always returns a card when candidates exist (combat.py:575-581), so the sim cannot decline. DORMANT for the skip half -- declining is strictly worse play and no replay command for it is wired -- but it is a missing player choice, not a re-architecture.

guards.what: BLAST RADIUS of creature_card_cmds step 52 (Downgrade skips Enchantment.ModifyCard())
guards.rationale: The seam's step 52 names a SOULS-enchanted Discovery as its witness: `DowngradeInternal` re-applies `Enchantment?.ModifyCard()` (CardModel.cs:2145) and the sim's `downgrade()` does not, so an enchantment that removes Exhaust is not re-applied after upgrade+downgrade. Flagged here, not re-verdicted: the mechanism is `Card.downgrade`'s, and Discovery's own keyword handling is correct.
